title: Ongoing hybrid program: semen extraction during abductions
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Ongoing hybrid program: semen extraction during abductions, about present day at not stated, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Whitley Strieber who talk about you know semen extraction taking place during alien abductions.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, was talking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels. He mentioned that the writer Whitley Strieber talks about semen being taken from people during alien abductions. The idea behind it is that if this happens, abductions would be part of an ongoing programme to breed human and alien hybrids.
